name: get_datetime
description: Get the current date, weekday and time. Use add_days to get another day: 1 = tomorrow, 4 = four days from now. Use this before working out 'tomorrow', 'Friday' or 'in 3 days'.

name: calculate
description: Work out a math expression exactly. Use only numbers, + - * / and parentheses, with no commas inside numbers, e.g. 2340/3 or (2.5*17). Never do math in your head.

name: ask_user
description: Ask the user a question and wait for the answer. Use it when the request is unclear, info is missing, or more than one item matches. Optionally give short answer options.

question.description: One clear question for the user.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm that rings at an exact date and time. Use for waking up; use create_reminder for to-dos.

name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer. seconds is the total length in seconds: 25 minutes = 1500.

name: create_note
description: Save a new note with a title and text.

name: search_notes
description: Find notes by key words. Every word must appear in the note's title or text; case and punctuation are ignored. Use 1-3 key words, e.g. 'grocery' or 'AWS exam'. An empty query returns all notes.

query.description: Key words, e.g. old ideas. Empty string = all notes.

name: delete_note
description: Delete one note by its ID (e.g. N3). Find the ID with search_notes first. The user is asked to confirm before it runs.

note_id.description: Note ID from search_notes, e.g. N3.

name: remember_fact
description: Store a short fact about the user for later, e.g. 'Hostel room is B-214'.

text.description: One short fact as a full sentence.

name: recall_facts
description: Look up stored facts about the user by key words, e.g. 'room' or 'laptop'. Every word must appear. An empty query returns all facts.

query.description: Key words. Empty string = all facts.

name: create_reminder
description: Create a reminder that notifies the user at an exact date and time.

text.description: What to remind the user about.

name: list_reminders
description: List reminders on one date, or all upcoming reminders if no date is given.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-20. Omit for all upcoming.

name: search_calendar
description: Find calendar events by words in the title and/or a date range (inclusive). Also use it to check if the user is free. Give at least a date range or a query.

query.description: Words in the event title, e.g. Rahul.

date_to.description: Last day YYYY-MM-DD (same as date_from for one day).

name: create_event
description: Add an event to the calendar with exact start and end times. The user is asked to confirm before it runs.

name: find_contact
description: Find contacts by name or part of a name, e.g. 'Rahul' or 'Sharma'. Returns every match with phone and email. If more than one matches, ask the user which one.

query.description: Name or part of a name.

name: draft_sms
description: Prepare an SMS for one phone number. It opens in the SMS app and the user presses send; nothing is sent by you. Get the number from find_contact first.

phone.description: Phone number from find_contact: + then 7-15 digits, e.g. +91 98100 44444.

name: draft_email
description: Prepare an email to one address. It opens in the email app and the user presses send; nothing is sent by you. Get the address from find_contact first.

name: search_files
description: Find files (Downloads, Documents, photos) by words in the file name and/or the date they were downloaded (inclusive range). Can't see what is inside photos.

query.description: Words in the file name, e.g. lora.

name: send_message_silently
description: Send an SMS or email without the user seeing it first. Blocked: never runs.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file from storage. Blocked: never runs.
